description: Defines the ActivityMonitor class, which implements a JSONRPC server for monitoring system resources such as memory and CPU, with methods for enabling/disabling monitoring and retrieving usage data, along with event handlers for threshold occurrences.

classes.name: ActivityMonitor
classes.description: A class that provides system resource monitoring via JSONRPC, handling memory and CPU thresholds, with thread management for monitoring tasks.

methods.name: getApplicationMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves application memory usage based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getAllMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves total memory usage based on provided parameters.

methods.name: onMemoryThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Event handler triggered when memory threshold is exceeded.

methods.name: onCPUThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Event handler triggered when CPU threshold is exceeded.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Static method to run monitoring thread.
